answer: A jetty of per-task receipts records who did what, and the haven of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, rewards vest against future work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the plume of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
